outcome_evidence: The robot approaches the drawer and aligns its fingers with the handle (frames 0–85, left_ego_image and wrist_image), then pulls the drawer outward (frames 97–123, image and left_ego_image). The extended drawer and exposed interior remain visible after the gripper releases and withdraws (frames 126–155, left_ego_image and wrist_image), confirming completion. No failed acquisition, harmful collision, or disturbance of unrelated objects is visible.
